name: LM393
description: The LM393 is a dual independent voltage comparator designed to operate from a single supply of 2V to 36V (or a split supply of +/-1V to +/-18V). Each comparator has open-collector outputs, so an external pullup resistor to a positive rail is required and outputs can be wired-OR together or driven to a different logic level than VCC. Its input common-mode range includes ground, making it well suited to single-supply systems. It is ubiquitous on hobby sensor breakout boards (sound-detection, IR line-follower, soil-moisture, and flame modules) where it provides a clean digital threshold output.

pins.name: 1OUT
pins.description: comparator 1 output, open-collector, needs external pullup

pins.name: 2OUT
pins.description: comparator 2 output, open-collector, needs external pullup

typical_application: single-supply threshold detection on sensor modules, producing a clean digital output when an analog level crosses a set reference.
gotchas: open-collector output REQUIRES an external pullup resistor to a positive rail
input common-mode range includes ground but the upper end is limited to VCC - 2V (only one input must stay in range)
shorting an output to VCC can cause excessive heating and destruction
